name: Tunnelsnake
author: Leandro Ciric
description: OpenVPN 3 and Firezone tunnel control in the Omarchy bar: pick a profile from anywhere on disk, connect, disconnect, and watch every running tunnel at a glance.

barWidget.description: Connect and disconnect OpenVPN 3 profiles or the Firezone client, and see which tunnels are running.

schema.label: VPN client
schema.description: The one client the widget drives. auto: openvpn3 when it is installed, otherwise Firezone. The panel has a picker for this when both are installed.

schema.label: VPN profile
schema.description: The profile the switch connects to. The panel's file picker writes this for you; leave it empty to use the first profile found.

schema.label: Profiles folder
schema.description: Folder scanned for .ovpn and .conf profiles. Downloads, ~/vpn, ~/openvpn and ~/.config/openvpn are always scanned too, along with anything imported into openvpn3.

schema.label: Tunnel DNS server
schema.description: Optional. Pinned on the tun device with resolvectl right after connecting.

schema.label: Tunnel search domains
schema.description: Optional, space separated. Prefix with ~ to route only that domain through the tunnel, e.g. ~internal.example.com.
